title: Measures to Mitigate against Concert Ticket Scams
what_it_is: Measures to Mitigate against Concert Ticket Scams

sections.label: SPF scam ad takedowns
sections.summary: The SPF worked with social media and e-commerce platforms to take down scam concert ticket advertisements and related accounts once detected.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The SPF worked closely with social media and e-commerce platforms to take down scam advertisements for concert tickets, as well as accounts involved in such scams as soon as they were detected.

sections.label: E-commerce Transaction Safety Ratings launch
sections.summary: The Inter-Ministry Committee on Scams launched the E-commerce Marketplace Transaction Safety Ratings in May 2022 to tackle e-commerce scams upstream.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: To tackle e-commerce scams upstream, the Inter-Ministry Committee on Scams launched the E-commerce Marketplace Transaction Safety Ratings (TSR) in May 2022.

sections.label: Facebook Marketplace TSR rating
sections.summary: Facebook Marketplace is rated the worst in the Transaction Safety Ratings.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For example, Facebook Marketplace is rated the worst in the TSR.

sections.label: Online Criminal Harms Act
sections.summary: In July 2023 MHA passed the Online Criminal Harms Act, letting the Government issue Directions to disable online criminal content and require upstream measures like user verification.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In July 2023, the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) passed the Online Criminal Harms Act, which will allow the Government to issue Directions to online platforms to disable online criminal content and activities, including scam-related ones.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Government can also require providers of designated online services to introduce upstream measures, such as user verification, to prevent scams from occurring in the first place.

sections.label: Buying concert tickets safely
sections.summary: For concert tickets, purchase only from authorised sellers and legitimate resellers such as Ticketmaster.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For concert tickets, only purchase from authorised sellers and legitimate resellers such as Ticketmaster.

sections.label: Concert ticket scam losses
sections.summary: Estimated total amounts lost in concert ticket scams were $84,000 in 2018, $66,000 in 2019, $9,000 in 2020, $3,000 in 2021, $175,000 in 2022, and $518,000 in 2023 up to 10 July.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: For the breakdown of the estimated total amount lost in concert ticket scams, in 2018, the amount was $84,000; in 2019, it was $66,000; in 2020, $9,000; in 2021, $3,000; in 2022, $175,000; and for 2023 up till 10 July, it was $518,000.
